verdict.rationale: Stripe documents extensive tooling that lets external AI agents act on an account: the hosted MCP server, agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and AI analytics via MCP. None of the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Stripe Dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. External-agent access is a different story, and Workbench Shell, Radar's fraud models and the third-party Kyber automation app are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
